needs.premise: Abstract admission/layout-operation, unknown custody, root-freeze/scan and resume histories. SC interleavings only; root mapping, C data races, allocator fit and liveness are not established.
Conditional gate preservation and explicit happens-before-chain composition. HB edges are premises, not derived from compiled C; Step covers close/publish/finish only.
Refine current-window, local reuse and global assignment to physical disjoint capacity without confusing thresholds/fudge/collector chunks; cover all layout writers and unknown native results.
Refactor embedded app producer before POP_ARGS2; prove stable-input or single-read mutable staging, exact root coverage/read-error order and argument limit.
Prepare logical call across _front evaluation/copy interleaving; certify location moves, all safepoints, inlining/local ABI and late-binding timing, not only targ-gen-jump.

Prove RootHandle or inherited parent-borrow origin before any wait/root copy; raw movable SCMOBJ ingress without prior root authority is rejected. Protect proc and incoming SCMOBJ before marker allocation, root each converted prefix; reserve only after collecting conversions and before outgoing stores; prove catcher/cleanup ownership.

Collector-updateable RootView scanner for every context, nested view lifetime, native borrow exclusion, old-reader pin and relocation reload; processor0 RC scanning does not close arbitrary-owner roots.

Concrete gate/allocator lock order, C object provenance, reads-from and release/acquire edges, complete writer coverage and descriptor reclamation; current target macros are not automatically qualified.
Prove logical root custody despite changed physical layout on denial, close/enter linearization, unknown debt reconciliation and same-call reentry without duplicate construction.

Physical grant names one actual msection incarnation/semispace/layout and contiguous cursor window plus stack interval; exclude chunk link and end markers, require word alignment/checked offset arithmetic, heapHi<=stackLo when sharing, and no conflicting allocator/writer capability; logical global free space, fudge and compile-time reserved counters are not this proof; grant leaves hp unchanged so this profile needs no new sparse/uninitialized-gap scan contract; account initialized prefix plus unused reserved words once, and close/refund only unused capacity, never committed objects

Preflight failure or cancellation retains exact logical target, ordered evaluated arguments/input spine, original continuation and native marker/code/result backing in collector-updateable roots; immutable/version-stable apply input can count then expand, general mutable input requires qualified single-read scan-safe staging, not rereading expressions/list after GC; no GC from existing unframed raw outgoing area; unknown source/input-root closure rejects managed profile

Canonical noncollecting tryReserve on complete rooted input view is final allocator-layout effect before a no-GC/no-reentry shuffle/repair interval; reserve includes all rest pairs from first CONS plus fallback packet, frame/argument stack and metadata budgets; unused grant cancellation and construction entry share one arbitration; no intervening allocating helper/POLL or legacy heap_limit cursor migration while lease live; initialize objects then advance actual prefix hp, close lease at complete FrameReady before GC

Release-publish complete rooted call view before reservation; same atomic registry serializes grant/cancel/enter and GC/layout close; allocation owner and disjoint actual intervals validated before canonical grant, acquire consumer validates server status/epoch/layout/serial/input plus current cursor; last constructor store/initialized prefix and full frame precede lease close and GC admission; collector relocation precedes acquire root reload and new grant; old replies cannot mutate claimed writer permit, stale refund cannot retire new grant; actual C pointer arithmetic/atomics/lock order and helper effects remain open

callers.actualChain: wrapper rest splice -> app -> POP_ARGS2 -> PUSH/CAR/CDR -> POP_ARGS_IN_REGS -> JUMPEXTNOTSAFE
callers.hazard: Insert a framed root/staging helper before POP_ARGS2; preserve post-splice proc,args, continuation and initialized staging prefix. The embedded C body is a hand-written producer, not generated by targ-gen-jump.
callers.replacement: Count/expand only immutable or qualified stable input; otherwise single-read staging with rooted progress, same read/error order and overflow handling.

callers.actualChain: slot arguments evaluated and saved -> register operands evaluated/spilled -> reload -> adjust-slots -> seal-bb -> make-jump -> C checks/adjust/jump
callers.hazard: Existing front-end interleaves evaluation and placement. Add a logical call preparation region and rooted value-location plan; a macro inserted only in targ-gen-jump is too late to reconstruct overwritten inputs.
callers.replacement: Preserve chosen evaluation order and late global lookup timing; no poll or allocation after final grant. Front-end and backend must agree on every copy, R0 and frame map.

callers.actualChain: BEGIN_SFUN marker -> prioritized SCMOBJ parameter conversion -> make-body SFUN_ARG loop -> SFUN_CALL -> ___call builds return frame
callers.hazard: Root proc and all incoming SCMOBJ values before marker allocation; publish a typed conversion view with safe initialized prefix before any collecting conversion; final reserve after conversions and before first SFUN_ARG.
callers.replacement: Root ingress must inherit a still-live parent borrow/epoch pin or registered RootHandle origin before waiting for admission; bare movable SCMOBJ ingress cannot become safe retroactively by taking the gate. Original native activation/catcher remains live. Unannotated allocating/reentrant converters reject this profile.

callers.actualChain: make_vector -> write marker proc/id -> publish pointer; kill clears element0 then decrements still refcount
callers.hazard: The explicit proc_or_false GC-protection TODO precedes conversion. Existing RC registration is PSTATE-local while mark_rc is called in the processor0 branch; do not assume an arbitrary processor RC is a complete view.
callers.replacement: Generated RootView must have an explicit scan/update adapter for every admitted context; still refcount is lifetime, not complete relocation-root coverage.

allocators.actualPath: prepare_mem_pstate publishes policy heap_limit/stack_limit; heap_limit may choose another section
allocators.contract: Owner materializes fp/hp before helper; validate current backing object, semispace, guards, max simultaneous FrameSpec demand and no conflicting lease; use checked offsets within each backing object.
allocators.failure: Fast path may reserve current disjoint window with hp unchanged; policy threshold is not physical capacity.
allocators.custodian: Context owns roots and backing until canonical unused cancellation or completed writer close.

allocators.actualPath: PSTATE-local msection_free_list pop -> set_heap_msection; sharing repartitions both limits
allocators.contract: A registered layout operation excludes GC/reset and same-context reentry; record list removal, prior/current section and layout generation before exposing grant.
allocators.failure: Known denial after a layout change preserves logical inputs, not necessarily old physical cursors/layout. No rollback over initialized objects.
allocators.custodian: Before assignment commit, context/VM arena escrow retains popped section; after commit, context owns it even if response lost.

allocators.actualPath: ALLOC_MEM_LOCK -> approximate global free check -> next_heap_msection_without_locking -> sharing logic
allocators.contract: Register layout debt under short VM gate, release gate, acquire existing alloc lock, assign, release alloc lock, commit known result under gate. No waiting or callback under either lock; no nested gate/alloc lock.
allocators.failure: GC close rejects new operations, waits outside locks for existing debt to resolve. Native backing growth, if needed, is a separate escrowed stage, not proved by global free count.
allocators.custodian: Unknown assignment retains layout debt and backing; timeout cannot declare denial or free the section.

allocators.actualPath: collector chunk start/end/first link setup versus mutator section switching
allocators.contract: Build a MutatorLayoutAdapter for the exact current mode. Do not call prepare_heap_msection blindly on every mutator switch or impose collector chunk size as rest limit.
allocators.failure: Exclude actual metadata and guards in the selected layout; old whole-half arithmetic is only a candidate envelope.
allocators.custodian: Any unqualified chunk/header mode remains unresolved and cannot issue managed capacity.

allocators.actualPath: GC flips/reset sections -> phase completion -> context preparation -> restored rest helper
allocators.contract: Close gate -> cancel unused -> drain active/layout operations -> freeze roots -> scan/update -> prepare context -> release resume seal -> acquire/reload.
allocators.failure: Layout changes invalidate unused tickets even without a GC epoch change. Finished packets are not reconstructed.
allocators.custodian: GC owns frozen roots exclusively; native activation and result backing remain pinned until resume/exit acknowledgement.

orders.orderContract: Start from valid registered handles or an inherited parent root/epoch pin; initialize descriptor, exact SCMOBJ slots and map before registration unlock-release. Gate lock-acquire observes membership.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Published membership permits closure accounting; it does not authorize scanning a still-running writer. Root storage cannot be allocated while unrooted or under the gate.

orders.orderContract: Gate-serialized open-check plus increment layoutOps; result commit/decrement under same gate after allocator lock release.
orders.rejectedShortcut: No split open load then independent increment. close may precede completion; completion attaches backing/debt result but cannot issue a new grant after close.

orders.orderContract: Grant fields and unused state publish under gate unlock-release; consumer locks/acquires and rechecks owner, epoch, layout, serial, input, cursor and OPEN while changing UNUSED to ACTIVE.
orders.rejectedShortcut: A separate acquire load of ticket plus relaxed active count is insufficient. Registry storage remains pinned during query/enter; stamp equality alone does not prevent use-after-free.

orders.orderContract: Last initialized heap store, hp prefix, complete FrameSpec/R0 and no-native-borrow state precede gate unlock-release of PARKED. Collector lock-acquire checks all frozen members and zero active/layout debt.
orders.rejectedShortcut: GC closes admission before it waits. No collector scan of ACTIVE/unknown state; constructor completes bounded work after close without reopening admission.

orders.orderContract: Collector relocation writes precede release publication of round/context-ready seal. Same native activation acquires seal and reloads every admitted root before unfreezing/regrant.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Old C local copies, register caches, old tickets and old raw cursor values must not be reused. Original synchronous native result/exception ABI persists.

orders.orderContract: Detach descriptor/ticket under gate only after owner exit/terminal acknowledgement, no query/consumer pins, no collector snapshot readers and no unknown layout/native debt.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Release/acquire publication does not itself reclaim storage. Unknown owner stop or native write cannot be converted into a cancellation receipt.

orders.orderContract: Selected baseline: one short VM control mutex with acquire/release semantics; owner-private data remains ordinary C only under proved exclusive access.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Existing W_ALL/R_ALL are register synchronization macros, not a new publication protocol. Existing __sync/volatile/ticketlock variants require target audit; no lock-free or all-target C11 claim.

costs.removedWork: Remove j repeated rest heap checks/helper entries within a qualified lease
costs.addedCost: One preparation/validation and gate transitions; full-frame poll/pressure decision remains
costs.condition: Net CPU benefit requires saved checks/helpers > root, staging, gate and poll cost. No speedup measured.

costs.removedWork: Avoid section switching if current actual heap and stack ranges fit
costs.bound: 0 additional section payload in that case
costs.addedCost: Root slots, descriptor and retained continuation lifetime
costs.condition: No gain if policy override violates pressure/safepoint guarantees; full-view mapping must close.

costs.removedWork: Keep evaluated values without rerunning user code
costs.addedCost: Root reload and canonical layout-debt settlement
costs.condition: Failure does not imply cursor rollback; consumed pool backing remains counted.

costs.removedWork: Avoid rereading a mutating spine after GC
costs.bound: O(n) staged SCMOBJ slots; approximately n*wordBytes payload plus headers/maps
costs.addedCost: O(n) read/copy plus initialized-prefix root maintenance
costs.condition: Must preserve original observation/error order; stable-input fast path alone does not cover general apply.

costs.bound: Live input/root count determined by generated location plan
costs.addedCost: Additional spills or duplicate slots until move commit
costs.condition: No claim that every direct/local/inlined/late-global call shares one budget or safe cut.

costs.removedWork: Retire unrooted proc/SCMOBJ and outgoing-stack assumptions for managed entry
costs.bound: SCMOBJ live input slots plus initialized converted prefix
costs.addedCost: Conversion cleanup map, marker/root registration and activation pin
costs.condition: Unknown converter effects or nonzero-processor scan gap rejects admission.

costs.removedWork: Reuse existing pool rather than automatically grow it
costs.addedCost: Assignment may batch sections and retain old stack/copy backing
costs.condition: Small 112B/96B repair budget is not new-section/RSS/whole-round peak.

costs.removedWork: Replace split grant/GC close races with one linearization domain
costs.bound: O(1) gate operations per grant/entry/close; O(p) member closure
costs.addedCost: Potential cross-core mutex contention, scan pins, layoutOps debt
costs.condition: Do not add per-CONS atomics; per-context sharding requires a separate membership-close proof.

costs.removedWork: Prevent double refund and premature arena reclamation
costs.bound: Unknown layout/native obligation stays >=1 until resolved
costs.addedCost: Potential unbounded retention and GC wait
costs.condition: No bounded peak/GC-latency theorem without bounded stop/result evidence.

costs.removedWork: Count unique physical backing and live root/staging storage once
costs.bound: Peak=max_t(backing+roots+staging+nativeEscrow); reserved slice within same backing is not another allocation
costs.addedCost: Extra staging or escrow can dominate saved checks
costs.condition: No positive net peak reduction proved; reusable lease reduces work only under qualifying geometry and effects.
